CotManagedMoney.description:
Managed money positioning from the CFTC Commitments of Traders report.

The COT lags: it is surveyed on a Tuesday and published the following
Friday afternoon, so ``report_date`` is always earlier than the report date
and must be shown to the reader.

report_date.description: Tuesday the COT position was surveyed.
report_date.title: Report Date

published_date.description: Friday the report was released by the CFTC.
published_date.title: Published Date

managed_money_net_lots.description: Long minus short, in contracts; signed.
managed_money_net_lots.title: Managed Money Net Lots

net_change_wow_lots.description: Week-on-week change in the net position, in contracts; signed.
net_change_wow_lots.title: Net Change Wow Lots

net_oz.description: Net position converted to troy ounces using contract_size_oz.
net_oz.title: Net Oz

EtfFundFlow.description:
Holdings and flows for one exchange traded product.

In production these figures are **T+1**: issuers publish the prior day's
holdings in the morning, so the line reported at today's London close is
yesterday's bar. ``as_of_date`` on the section states the effective date.

ticker.description: Listing ticker, or "OTHER" for the aggregate line.
ticker.title: Ticker

holdings_tonnes.description: Total metal held, in metric tonnes.
holdings_tonnes.title: Holdings Tonnes

daily_change_tonnes.description: Change in holdings vs the prior report, in tonnes; positive is a creation.
daily_change_tonnes.title: Daily Change Tonnes

daily_change_usd.description: Daily change valued at the session close, in USD; sign matches tonnes.
daily_change_usd.title: Daily Change Usd

wtd_flow_tonnes.description: Week-to-date cumulative flow in tonnes; signed.
wtd_flow_tonnes.title: Wtd Flow Tonnes

mtd_flow_tonnes.description: Month-to-date cumulative flow in tonnes; signed.
mtd_flow_tonnes.title: Mtd Flow Tonnes

ytd_flow_tonnes.description: Year-to-date cumulative flow in tonnes; signed.
ytd_flow_tonnes.title: Ytd Flow Tonnes

ytd_flow_usd.description: Year-to-date cumulative flow valued in USD; signed.
